decision: Adopt the combined verifier as an optional quote-preserving API; original analyzer and text APIs unchanged.

artifact.training_source: National Institute of Korean Language (국립국어원), morphological corpus2021

selection.criterion: Development macro F1 across NX/SX and punctuation variants, includes missing gold outside frozen candidate set

artifact.policy: Balanced quotations are preserved by an explicit rule added after fixed-set error inspection. Original2021 source records sometimes split quotes; preserve both reference metrics.

training.architecture: Ordered character embeddings + structured features -> ReLU96 -> scalar logit
training.threshold_objective: Development macro F1 across NX/SX and punctuation variants, includes missing gold outside frozen candidate set

datasets.policy: NX original source-record boundaries, including both inside-quote positives and negatives; not consistently quote-preserving top-level boundaries. Paragraph membership from original IDs; original paragraph text unavailable. SX conservative single-final-EF record pairs remain weak labels.
datasets.normalization: underscore->space; all whitespace deleted; alternative deletes terminal punctuation per source record; exact codepoint targets

external.model_selection: All epochs/thresholds frozen on development data. External scores do not choose checkpoints.
external.quote_policy: All verifier paths and baseline_quote preserve matched quotation spans. Original reference labels unchanged. Added after inspecting fixed2025 failures; exploratory policy refinement, not untouched generalization.

before_quote_policy.model_selection: All epochs/thresholds frozen on development data. External scores do not choose checkpoints.

benchmark.scope: Loaded Node24/V8,1250 exact-aligned2025NX paragraphs sampled every7,625punctuated+625no_terminal,50warmup,7rotated paired rounds; model loading excluded; not browser-corpus latency.

limits: Quote preservation was added after inspecting fixed2025 errors. These are exploratory post-selection fixed-set scores, not untouched generalization.
Most of the improvement is explicit quote-policy alignment. Compare the same quote-only control to isolate learned gains.
2021 source records contain within-quote gold boundaries, so raw2021 accuracy falls under this top-level policy. Original labels were never changed for scoring.
Spoken source pairs are weakly labeled; the separate reviewed48records contain only8positive boundaries. No general spoken95percent claim.
The verifier can only veto frozen first-stage candidates and cannot recover boundaries absent from them.
Additional quantized weights are expanded to float32 arrays; this is not nativeINT4 arithmetic acceleration.

The combined loaded Node path is about25times slower than the lightweight splitter (about1.10ms per sampled paragraph), so it is opt-in. Browser functional validation is seven constructed cases, not a large browser-corpus latency benchmark.
Two training seeds provide a sensitivity check, not statistical confidence intervals or a model-capacity limit.
Straight quotation pairing is deterministic and cannot infer every intended quotation in malformed text.
resolved_implementation_issues: PyTorch2.8.0 MPS padding_idx gradient differed fromCPU; explicit output mask and zero-padding export guard now enforced. Initial invalid checkpoints excluded from all final evidence.

BLAS floating-status warnings occurred with finite bounded products; independent scalar/JS comparisons passed. Explicit intermediate/logit finiteness checks reject actual NaN/overflow; malformed score shapes and control-feature counts are rejected.
Prior fixed boundary references needed explicit text exclusion beyond new document partitioning; four training rows removed before model fitting.
